notes.title: The Last 48 hours are Upon Us!
notes.notes:
[p]In celebration of [b]the last 48 hours[/b] we put together a little teaser image from a bus scene that was cut from the demo (the intro would have been too long and slow paced). But we still plan on using it in some capacity in the final game. This scene has [b]parallax effects[/b] when the bus moves and it looks quite nice.[/p][p]In this image Maya just lost her phone to one of those pesky mind-controlled squirrels that inhabit this area. [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290954/e4e042832597f0e1468cac9e184c5ab2f4b08ebb.png"][/img][/p][p]If you want the game to be the best version it can be - [b]your support is important![/b] And If you still haven't told your estranged cousin's niece about the campaign - now is the perfect opportunity to drop a link into the group chat. [b]Every bit of exposure is welcome.[/b]

[b]Stay safe out there[/b][/p][p]Pierre Nilsson
[/p]

notes.title: Doomsday Valley just launched on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
[b]The Mystery of Doomsday Valley just launched on Kickstarter! [/b]

Together we can make this game a reality. We need every hand on board for this one!
Make sure to check out the campaign right away as there are a few limited rewards. 

It’s a mystery point and click game with hand-drawn animations and object-based puzzles. There is a playable demo if you want to take it out for a spin before you pledge.


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trueascension/the-mystery-of-doomsday-valley]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/trueascension/the-mystery-of-doomsday-valley[/url]

notes.title: Play the Demo!
notes.notes:
Today we [b]release a demo[/b] of our beloved new game -[b] The Mystery of Doomsday Valley.[/b] Take it out for a spin - the closed beta testers have responded well so far and seems to like the direction. That is what they are telling us anyway...

[b]Demo[/b]
This demo showcases what we want to achieve with Doomsday Valley, but it should be viewed as a work in progress and an early version. The final product will be even better and more polished, but this will give you a first impression about how the game will play.


Link for easy access:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687330

[b]Kickstarter[/b]
We will launch a kickstarter for this game in a few days, on[b] Tuesday the 13/5[/b] 2025. So be ready to back the project if you like what you see. Everything helps - if you can help us spread the word on social media or other venues we would be very grateful.

If you haven't already - go to [url=www.doomsdayvalley.com]www.doomsdayvalley.com[/url] and sign up for the Kickstarter. 

We are very happy to release this demo and are ready to do an interesting Kickstarter campaign. I hope you will join us for this adventure. Remember - something is happening to the poor citizens of Doomsday Valley and you are the only one with the power to help them!

Best regards / 
Pierre Nilsson and Karl Längberg
True Ascension Game Studio
